scope: original production GLiNER; read-only source audit plus standalone core preflight; no original-model parallel benchmark run

core_limit_probe.timing_scope: single Vault.direction call; excludes allocation; not a performance benchmark

preflight_sources.finding: first check_input rejects any input over 32 MiB; plain anonymization is additionally limited to 1 MiB
independent service direction preflight precedes state lock and model loading
direct NER API rejects inputs over 1 MiB before window preparation and inference

resource_limits.preparation_memory: O(all lexical units) words vector plus O(distinct cached subword IDs); not a bounded document stream
notes: 50 MiB currently fails before NER; this does not demonstrate 50 MiB anonymization
core new-mapping and original-byte capacities are checked before mutation
full candidate collection, overlap resolution, output materialization and exact round trip would also require a reviewed large-input design

original_windowing.preserve_for_comparison: original weights, tokenizer, prompt labels, threshold, budget, overlap, per-window tensors and deterministic merge order

coordinator_and_cancellation.state_lock: Arc<Mutex<NerState>> held across original model inference and core processing; serializes service operations
coordinator_and_cancellation.cancel_mechanism: atomic generation and cache epoch; stale progress/results rejected
coordinator_and_cancellation.parallel_candidate_requirement: shared generation/deadline; bounded in-flight work; no new scheduling after cancellation; discard stale outputs and do not paste

ort.configured: intra-op threads and Level3 graph optimization
ort.binding_warning: source warns that Sync concurrency segfaults with CUDA, DirectML and apparently non-CPU execution providers

sequence.role: second candidate only if first justifies it

proposed_original_cpu_candidates.design: prepare original windows once, bound queued batches, independent owned tensors/contexts per run, share one CPU session, merge in original window order
proposed_original_cpu_candidates.memory_note: shared session avoids duplicating weights; concurrent activations still grow; multiple sessions would duplicate resident model and thread pools
proposed_original_cpu_candidates.acceptance: measure complete-document wall time and peak resources, then exact original-range/category parity, quality/core/round-trip and cancellation; tensor throughput alone is insufficient

historical_original_apple_candidate.architecture: CoreML FP32 original encoder B8 plus original ONNX CPU tail
historical_original_apple_candidate.proof_scope: tensor screening; not document windowing/core/round-trip/native UI or hardware runtime trace
historical_original_apple_candidate.proposed_change: encoder batch n+1 overlaps CPU-tail batch n with double buffer and queue capacity 1
historical_original_apple_candidate.estimate_assumptions: perfect overlap, unchanged stage times, no resource contention or extra transfer/merge overhead
